characterization_methods: Time of flight-secondary ion mass spectrometry (ToF-SIMS)
evidence: Grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) and X-ray reflectivity (XRR) spectra were acquired... Far infrared transmission spectra (far-IRTS) were measured... Atomic force microscopy (AFM) measurements were performed... Time of flight-secondary ion mass spectrometry (ToF-SIMS) depth profiles were acquired... Capacitance–voltage (C–V) curves of the metallic–insulator–semiconductor (MIS) structures were acquired... current density–voltage (J–V) curves were obtained using a HP 4140A pico-amperometer.
